description: Get the outline of a cadastral parcel as GeoJSON and/or a [lat, lng] ring, plus its centroid and area, for mapping and GIS work. Accepts references from the same 30 codes as get_parcel (every covered country except the United Kingdom, which is coordinates only).

country.description: Optional country code. Omit to auto-detect from the reference format.

name: get_boundaries
title: Get Parcel Boundaries
